intent: REFACTOR ReactorTelemetryStreamGateway: inspect the implementation for layering violations, blocking calls, unbounded buffers, hardcoded values and invariant gaps; improve clarity without changing the public surface or breaking tests. Spec: Telemetry Stream Broadcasting adapter implementing TelemetryStreamGateway. Constructor ReactorTelemetryStreamGateway(int subscriberBuffer>0). Backed by Sinks.many().multicast().directBestEffort(); publish emits non-blocking (no subscribers or slow subscribers never block or fail the publisher); items() = sink.asFlux().onBackpressureBuffer(subscriberBuffer, BufferOverflowStrategy.DROP_OLDEST) so each subscriber's demand is respected with bounded memory.
